title: Continents
info: A continent is a very large area of land.
Most school maps show seven continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia, Europe, North America, and South America.
Asia is the largest continent by area and population. Australia is the smallest.
Antarctica is the coldest continent and has no permanent human population.
Continents are made up of countries and oceans surround them.
